_comment: Stage 2 classifications for scripts/tag6_cost.py's TAG 6 pipeline (TAGGING_SPEC_v0.5.md sec. 3). This sandbox has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY configured, so these were classified directly by Claude in the same session that built this pipeline, standing in for the live API call the script makes when a key is present. The real 'uterine fibroids' corpus produced zero Stage 1 keyword hits (see reports/milestone_7_status.md), so none of these are real corpus sentences - they're synthetic fixtures proving Stage 2/3 actually discriminate correctly, including the negation-like case (entry 4) that a naive keyword match would get wrong.
